summary: Diagram node descriptions, list notes and resting edge labels are set in the footnote role instead of label-sm with a font-regular override (#59). An active edge's label is label-sm at 600, as before, now by role rather than by an exception. The size and weight are unchanged (12px, 400). The leading moves from label-sm's 1.3 to footnote's 1.35, so a line is 16.2px instead of 15.6px.
